title: Gali Ka Panther
style: Hindi phonk with half-time trap groove, sly syncopated drums, rubbery sub-bass, beatboxing, and cheeky local percussion colors. Verse rides sparse kick, clap, and whispered callouts; pre-chorus tightens with filtered risers and harmonic singing; chorus snaps wide with gang ad-libs, Spanish licks, and playful backing voices. Close-mic lead, stacked doubles, bright and punchy mix with dusty low end and comic ear candy., comedy
lyrics:
[Intro]
Ha ha, सुन ना
Beatbox karein, bhai

[Verse 1]
Nukkad pe chalta style mera
Panther sa, but full-on sahi re
Chai ki tapri, scene bhi heavy
Meri gully boli, “oye, wahi re”

Rickshaw pe swag, जुगाड़ ka king
Mango chutney, with my bling-bling
Tu dekhe toh bole, “qué pasó?”
Main haste-haste bolu, “bro, you know”

[Pre-Chorus]
Aaja, aaja, थोड़ा पास
Mundiya, tu karna na fuss
Paani puri, spicy kiss
Mera mood बोले, “sí, sí, this!”

[Chorus]
Gali ka panther
Gali ka panther
Chupke se dhanter
Sab ko kar de dander

Gali ka panther
Gali ka panther
Mast, funny, slicker
(ay caramba) closer, quicker

[Verse 2]
Mama ki daant, main smile karun
Baba ke samne seedha चाल chalu
Society gate pe aunties stare
Main seedha bolu, “namaste, mere”

Auto wale bhai ka remix tez
Paper plate pe full masala craze
“Bro, thoda slow” — “no, no, amigo”
Main dhool mein chamku, panther ego

[Pre-Chorus]
Aaja, aaja, थोड़ा पास
Mundiya, tu karna na fuss
Paani puri, spicy kiss
Mera mood बोले, “sí, sí, this!”

[Chorus]
Gali ka panther
Gali ka panther
Chupke se dhanter
Sab ko kar de dander

Gali ka panther
Gali ka panther
Mast, funny, slicker
(ay caramba) closer, quicker

[Bridge]
[Beatbox break]
Tch-ka, tch-ka, boom-bam
Naach le, bhai, tam-tam
Harmonic sa “oh-oh” glide
Local heart, worldwide ride

[Final Chorus]
Gali ka panther
Gali ka panther
Chupke se dhanter
Sab ko kar de dander

Gali ka panther
Gali ka panther
Mast, funny, slicker
(ay caramba) closer, quicker

Gali ka panther
Gali ka panther
Nukkad ka superstar
Sab bole, “oye, yaar”
